title: TUP Manila Campus Event Registration
summary: A TUP Manila student signs in, selects an available event, registers once, and receives a QR ticket.
edge_cases: The email domain is not an allowed TUP Manila domain.
The event becomes full while the student is submitting registration.
The student already has a registration for the event.
The student tries to cancel inside the 24-hour window.
The QR ticket is cancelled and must not be accepted at check-in.

nodes.label: Open event portal
nodes.description: The student opens the campus event portal and chooses to sign in.

nodes.label: Enter school email
nodes.description: The student enters a TUP Manila school email address.

nodes.label: Email domain allowed?
nodes.description: The system checks whether the email belongs to the configured TUP Manila domain.

nodes.label: Show sign-in error
nodes.description: The system explains that only an allowed school email can continue.

nodes.label: View event listings
nodes.description: The authenticated student sees published events, dates, venues, and remaining capacity.

nodes.label: Seat available?
nodes.description: The system checks whether the selected event still has capacity.

nodes.label: Show event full
nodes.description: The student sees that registration is closed because the event has reached capacity.

nodes.label: Register with one click
nodes.description: The student selects Register and the server creates one registration with a capacity-safe check.

nodes.label: Registration accepted?
nodes.description: The system reports whether the write succeeded, was a duplicate, or lost a capacity race.

nodes.label: Explain registration result
nodes.description: The system explains duplicate, full, or temporary failure and offers the correct next action.

nodes.label: Display unique QR ticket
nodes.description: The system shows the confirmed event ticket with its unique opaque QR token.

nodes.label: Cancel before deadline?
nodes.description: The student may choose to cancel only while more than 24 hours remain and check-in has not happened.

nodes.label: Cancel registration
nodes.description: The system marks the registration cancelled, invalidates the ticket, and releases the seat.

nodes.label: Ticket ready for check-in
nodes.description: The student keeps the active QR ticket for future attendance verification.

nodes.label: Keep active ticket
nodes.description: The system explains that the cancellation window has closed and leaves the active ticket unchanged.

edges.note: Continue to the published event list
Access is restricted to the configured school domain
Reuse the existing registration and ticket

edges.condition: deadline passed or already checked in

edges.note: The exit label explains the cancelled state
